flows.recipient: the selected website and its referenced services
data: cookies and site state allowed by Chromium
flows.retentionByBlanc: history locally unless private; site storage locally in the selected session

flows.trigger: eligible typed prefix after the fresh-profile choice is saved on, or while the retained setting is on
flows.default: presented on during fresh-profile choice; user may turn off before continuing

flows.trigger: on macOS, the user enables the device-local integration, invokes Fill on a detected login form, and authorizes Blanc in the 1Password desktop app
flows.recipient: the user's installed 1Password desktop app and the 1Password account service it uses
data: configured 1Password account name or account ID
vault and Login-item overview metadata needed for local website matching
when several items match, the built-in usernames of at most ten candidates plus their non-secret SDK item versions needed to distinguish and bind the native chooser
the selected Login item's built-in username and/or password required by the detected fields
flows.retentionByBlanc: account routing metadata stays device-local in settings; returned metadata and credentials are transient memory only and are never persisted, logged, synced, or sent to Bananify

flows.trigger: packaged launch after the fresh-profile choice is saved on, or while the retained setting is on
flows.default: presented on during fresh-profile choice; user may turn off before continuing
flows.recipient: Blanc Cloudflare Worker; optional Google Analytics mirror
data: edge address for short-lived rate limiting
flows.retentionByBlanc: raw UUID immediately HMACed; expiring keyed cohort markers; aggregate counts long-term

flows.trigger: explicit sync setup and later enabled sync cycles
flows.retentionByBlanc: ciphertext until a configured client requests account wipe

flows.trigger: user explicitly asks to import one selected supported browser window
flows.recipient: OpenAI connected-browser processing followed by Blanc Cloudflare Worker
flows.retentionByBlanc: plaintext and generated key only during request validation and encryption; relay stores ciphertext until claim or authenticated expiry, then only a used-ID marker until that original expiry (at most ten minutes); request bodies are not intentionally logged

flows.trigger: user selects eligible tabs from the current non-private window and chooses Open in Blanc
flows.retentionByBlanc: ciphertext until the first successful claim or authenticated expiry; a used-ID marker remains only until that original expiry (at most ten minutes); the key remains in the source browser and launch-link fragment

flows.trigger: user opens a valid blanc-import capability URL
flows.retentionByBlanc: claimed ciphertext is replaced atomically by an expiry-only used-ID marker until the original expiry; decrypted tab metadata remains only in memory until accept or cancel, then accepted URLs enter ordinary local session state

flows.trigger: a non-private page supplies a remote icon for browser chrome
flows.default: automatic for regular tabs; suppressed for private tabs
flows.retentionByBlanc: only a validated fixed-size PNG; no remote source URL; current pinned fetch bypasses Electron proxy and encrypted-DNS settings

flows.trigger: packaged startup, periodic check, or explicit check
flows.retentionByBlanc: update metadata and downloaded signed artifact as required by updater

flows.trigger: DNS resolution under selected resolver mode
flows.recipient: system resolver or user-selected DoH provider

flows.trigger: user explicitly selects, reviews, or applies a source in Bring Your Tabs
flows.default: off; no source is read until explicit selection
flows.recipient: Blanc main process and bounded utility renderer projection; no network recipient
flows.retentionByBlanc: memory-only import session for at most 15 minutes; destroyed on cancel, apply, window close, profile deletion, or quit; accepted tabs enter ordinary local session state; never sent to the handoff relay

flows.trigger: visit to a page with download controls
user chooses a platform artifact from a Blanc download control
flows.recipient: Blanc Cloudflare Worker followed by GitHub Releases
data: ordinary edge request metadata processed by Cloudflare and GitHub
flows.retentionByBlanc: aggregate per-day, per-target counts and a cached public GitHub asset list in KV; no IP address, user agent, cookie, or per-user identifier stored by Blanc

flows.trigger: non-legal page load in restricted mode; visitor clicks Allow for full measurement
flows.default: restricted cookieless Consent Mode with analytics storage denied
data: restricted cookieless measurement pings by default
page and explicitly instrumented CTA events
flows.retentionByBlanc: consent choice in site localStorage; analytics in configured Google property

flows.trigger: address submission followed by mailbox confirmation
data: edge address for short-lived rate limiting
flows.retentionByBlanc: pending request up to 24 hours; honeypot quarantine up to 30 days; confirmed record until one-click unsubscribe or deletion
